<thought>Based on the monoisotopic mass (182.073 Da) and the observed M+1 intensity (~14 %), the molecular formula is most consistent with C₁₃H₁₀O. This formula corresponds to benzophenone (diphenyl ketone). Its SMILES representation is “O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
